The refactor is complete and all tests pass.

**Summary of changes:**

- **`src/plugin.ts`** — `Plugin` interface with the 5 lifecycle hooks (`onStart`, `beforeBuild`, `afterBuild`, `onFile(page)`, `onEnd`), `PluginContext`, and a synchronous/async pipeline runner (`runSyncHooks`, `runHooksAsync`, `applyOnFile`, `applyOnFileAsync`).
- **`src/plugins/markdown.ts`** — `MarkdownPlugin` extracts markdown parsing; its `onFile` renders raw markdown → HTML.
- **`src/plugins/template.ts`** — `TemplatePlugin` wraps `TemplateEngine` (rendering + built-in templates).
- **`src/plugins/dev-server.ts`** — `DevServerPlugin` wraps `DevServer`.
- **`src/load-plugins.ts`** — loads plugins from `ssg.config.ts` (transpiles TS at runtime), resolving plugin module paths from `./plugins/`.
- **`src/build.ts`** — core engine now orchestrates the plugin pipeline (onStart → beforeBuild → load raw pages → onFile → render templates → afterBuild → onEnd), while keeping `build`/`loadPages`/`findMarkdownFiles` signatures and behavior identical.
- **`src/ssg.ts`** — added optional `content` (raw markdown) to `Page`.
- **`plugins/hello-world.ts`** — sample user plugin demonstrating the `./plugins/` extension point.

Existing external APIs (`parseFrontmatter`, `markdownToHtml`, `normalizeTags`, `TemplateEngine`, `DevServer`, `parseArgs`, etc.) are untouched.
